svg.text: ESP32-S3 as application processor / hub; ESP32-PICO-MINI-02 as the Bluetooth-keyboard co-processor
Bluetooth Classic + BLE — the only part
on the board with BT Classic
S3 ↔ PICO inter-MCU link — seven wires, not two
S3 GPIO36 → PICO RX — UART1, 921600 8N1, no flow ctrl [CONFIRMED]
S3 GPIO17 → PICO RESET — idle LOW, 10 ms active-HIGH pulse [CONFIRMED]
S3 GPIO35 → PICO REQ — the PICO's own 'READY_IN' [strongly indicated]
S3 GPIO47 → PICO STROBE — asserted around a framed send [strongly indicated]
S3 GPIO46 ← PICO READY — HIGH=ready to receive, any-edge+ISR [CONFIRMED]
S3 GPIO48 ← ? — any-edge input, ISR posts unconsumed values [wiring CONFIRMED, meaning unverified]
No IO0/BOOT strap between the two MCUs — the PICO firmware update is an
application-level protocol over this same UART (confirmed negative).
I2C port 0 — SDA GPIO18 / SCL GPIO10, 1 MHz,
No display reset GPIO anywhere — bring-up is I2C-only (confirmed negative).
OUTPUT, driven LOW at boot = power held
ON; driving it HIGH cuts power
S3 GPIO14 → single WS2812 addressable LED,
R56/R57 + C43 near the CC contacts may be the 5.1kΩ Rd sink pull-downs (possible).
VBUS sense GPIO: none. USB power-switch GPIO: none. (confirmed negatives)
CONFIRMED — read from the cell label
ADC1_CH0 = GPIO1, 12-bit, 12 dB atten [CONFIRMED from firmware;
both input+internal pull-up, polled, active LOW)
pin→state mapping CONFIRMED; driving IC is
No external USB data mux. The TUSB320 only reports CC/attach state over I2C; the switch
between the USB-Serial-JTAG controller and the USB-OTG controller is internal to the S3,
SDMMC slot 1, 1-bit: CLK GPIO5, CMD GPIO3,
D0 GPIO4, 40 MHz max, mounted at /SDCARD
card detect GPIO40, input + internal pull-up,
driver cd/wp are both -1: detect is polled on a separate pin,
not wired into the SDMMC driver.
Two shielded switching inductors ⇒ at least two switching stages
(strongly indicated). No PD controller, fuse, PTC or fuel gauge identified.
only reg 0x09 (status) is ever read; bit
used as an attach/charger sensor only
I2C port 1 — SDA GPIO8 / SCL GPIO9,
S3 GPIO41 ← TUSB320 INT: input, no pull,
five buttons, active-LOW, no internal pulls
which physical switch is which is only partly established: front power =
WAKE (strongly indicated); the four back switches are not individually
Box border style follows the same code.
GPIO39 — output, driven LOW once at boot,
J4 — a second 2-pin red/black connector that is
NOT labelled VBAT; purpose unknown, do not
IC3 top mark reads TPS / 25910 / TI 85I / C400 —
marking confirmed, device and function unknown.
Every electrical fact here was recovered from the stock firmware image or read off the board; nothing has been measured with an instrument.
